description.value: Vancouver Island's largest winery, Church and State Wines sits in Brentwood Bay just 15 minutes from downtown Victoria, pouring award-winning BC VQA wines grown exclusively on their own estate vineyards on Vancouver Island and in the Okanagan. The property features a tasting bar and a full bistro menu, plus a covered veranda and event programming that includes yoga in the vineyard and seasonal brunches. Named #1 Small Winery in British Columbia, it is a worthy scenic detour for cyclists riding the Saanich Peninsula near BC Ferries.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is Vancouver Island's largest winery with a tasting room and bistro at the OSM address (1445 Benvenuto Avenue, Victoria, BC, V8M 1J5) and phone (250-652-2671). The website content makes no mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities, so all such fields are null. The winery is confirmed open with posted hours and is a notable food-and-drink destination on the Saanich Peninsula for touring cyclists traveling between BC Ferries and Victoria.
concerns: OSM lists city as 'Victoria' but the winery is located in Brentwood Bay; the website consistently refers to it as the Brentwood Bay location. The address is accurate but the community label may mislead cyclists.
No bike-specific amenities (rack, parking, water refill) could be confirmed from the website; a follow-up visit or contact is recommended to verify these before publishing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, award-winning winery and bistro 15 minutes from downtown Victoria on a popular cycling corridor near BC Ferries; a clear Food & Drink destination of interest to touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: Named #1 Small Winery in British Columbia... Vancouver Island's largest winery

price.label: Casual
price.signal: Island's largest winery tasting bar; full bistro, tier tasting casual
